messages:
sasha: Onboarding Maelstrom-9B into our model catalog. License attached from the vendor has a 'non-commercial' paragraph and a redistribution clause that looks restrictive. Can we host (paid) or provide quantized weights to Dedicated customers? cc @olivia-legal
olivia-legal: Thanks for the ping. Can you paste the exact license text? quick read suggests it's a custom license, not standard CC. Need the clause around "commercial use" and "derivatives". :eyes:
sasha: pasted excerpt:
```
Section 3. Permitted Use: Licensee may use the Model for research and internal evaluation. Commercial hosting, offering inference as a paid service, or redistributing model weights (including quantized variants) is prohibited without explicit permission from Licensor.
```
raj: So it explicitly calls out quantized variants -> they treat qweights as redistribution/derivative. That would block hosted API and our default Dedicated redistrib path.
mika: For Private deployments where customer supplies the model (BYOW) — are we OK to run inference on their infra? no redistribution there.
olivia-legal: Running the model in a customer-managed environment (BYOW on their infra or VPC with them providing the weights) is generally fine since we're not redistributing or hosting the weights. But if we take the weights into our systems (even for quantization) and re-distribute to customers, that's redistribution. Also note: offering inference via our hosted paid API likely counts as commercial use.
legal-bot: @sasha Reminder: open ticket with vendor for permission using template: `third_party_license_clarify`.
sasha: Ok. Follow-ups: 1) Can we ask vendor for a permissive addendum that allows quantized redistributions to Dedicated customers under an SLA? 2) Short-term mitigations — label Maelstrom as "research-only" in catalog and disable hosted/managed serving for now.
raj: Technical question — could we implement a 'no-transfer' serving mode where we stream logits and never store weights to our infra? Would that mitigate redistribution concerns? mika?
mika: Stream-only would still be commercial hosting if we're running inference on our GPUs. The license forbids commercial hosting; vendor may object. If customer provides weights and we run on their infra (Private), that's safe.
olivia-legal: Recommended next steps: 1) Sasha opens vendor permission ticket, attach quote of clause. 2) Product flag: mark model research-only and block hosted/dedicated from provisioning. 3) Engineering: add a metadata tag "license: restrict-commercial, restrict-redistrib" so onboarding UI blocks incompatible flows. 4) If vendor grants addendum, require written permission attached to model record.
sasha: I'll open the ticket and update the model onboarding checklist. Thanks all. :partyparrot:
raj: noted, will add the metadata hook to the onboarding pipeline. mika: I'll update the console UI to grey out hosted options for Maelstrom until cleared.
olivia-legal: I'll draft the vendor permission email and share a template.
